backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that stores and retrieves game leaderboard entries, supporting score submission by nickname and sorted leaderboard queries with a configurable limit.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no recorded features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that preloads Cinzel Decorative, Cinzel, and Lato Google Fonts and mounts the React app under the root div with the title 'Deen Runner - Halal Muslim Adventure'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that routes between menu, character-select, leaderboard, playing, and game-over screens, wiring game state callbacks from useGameState to GameScene and GameHUD.
frontend/src/game/characters/index.ts: Defines the CharacterDef interface and exports three Islamic-themed playable characters (Ahmad, Fatima, Sheikh Omar) with colors, headwear types, and descriptions.
frontend/src/game/GameHUD.tsx: Overlay HUD component displaying score, coin count, active power-up name with a depleting timer bar, shield status, and a speed meter using bar segments.
frontend/src/game/GameScene.tsx: Core 3D endless runner scene built with React Three Fiber, handling lane movement, jump/slide physics, procedural obstacle and collectible spawning, collision detection, and Islamic-themed environment rendering.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGameState.ts: Custom React hook that manages all game state including screen navigation, score, coins, speed, power-ups, and personal best (persisted to localStorage). Exposes actions like startGame, triggerGameOver, activatePowerUp, and consumeShield.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching the leaderboard (useLeaderboard) and submitting a player score (useSubmitScore) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind with a desert/Islamic warm color palette, and defines custom utility classes for Islamic-themed UI elements like buttons, panels, and text shadows.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, mounting it to the root DOM element.
frontend/src/screens/CharacterSelect.tsx: Character selection screen that displays a grid of selectable character cards with previews, color swatches, and descriptions, allowing the player to pick a runner before starting the game.
frontend/src/screens/GameOver.tsx: Game over screen that displays the player's final score, coins, and personal best, and allows the player to submit their score to the leaderboard with a nickname before retrying or returning to the menu.
frontend/src/screens/Leaderboard.tsx: React component that displays the game leaderboard, fetching scores via `useLeaderboard` hook and rendering ranked entries with gold/silver/bronze styling, loading/error states, and navigation back to the main menu.
frontend/src/screens/MainMenu.tsx: React component for the main menu screen, showing the game logo, navigation buttons to play, character select, and leaderboard, plus a controls hint panel with keyboard shortcuts.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom Islamic-themed colors (sand-gold, terracotta, deep-teal, ivory), custom fonts (Cinzel Decorative, Lato), box shadows, border radii, and animation keyframes for the project.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 5) describing the halal Muslim-themed endless runner game, its architectural notes, existing implemented features, known issues, and required image assets.
